review_notes: I read the whole file. I also read StructureConstants, Basis and Eigenrow in the same directory, and grepped for uses of the lemmas. Simp coverage is mostly sound. `classMultMatrix_apply` and `classMultMatrix_mk_one` are simp, and `classMultMatrix_map_intCast` and `classMultMatrix_eq_leftMulMatrix` are rightly not simp. Making either of those simp would turn the `(classMultMatrix _).map Int.cast` form into `leftMulMatrix` and compete with `classMultMatrix_apply` and `Matrix.map_apply`. The one gap I found is that the entrywise `leftMulMatrix` lemma is not simp. I could not run Lean, so I did not check whether `Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul` or other Mathlib simp lemmas already rewrite this expression to the same normal form. I also did not check how the simp-set would behave downstream.

findings.excerpt:
theorem leftMulMatrix_classSumCenter_apply (Cᵢ Cⱼ Cₖ : ConjClasses G) :
    Algebra.leftMulMatrix (classSumBasis (k := k)) (classSumCenter Cᵢ) Cⱼ Cₖ =
      (structureConstant Cᵢ Cₖ Cⱼ : k)
findings.problem: This is the entrywise evaluation of `Algebra.leftMulMatrix` at the class-sum basis and `classSumCenter`, and it is not tagged `@[simp]`. Its sibling `classMultMatrix_apply` is simp, and so are the lemmas it depends on (`classSumBasis_apply`, `classSumBasis_repr_apply`, `centerToConjClasses_mk`, `classSumCenter_coe`). So `classMultMatrix Cᵢ Cⱼ Cₖ` simplifies to structure constants, but the equivalent `leftMulMatrix` entry has no simp normal form. The lemma is only reached through an explicit `simp only [...]` list (line 94). Its LHS is specific, because the basis and the element are fixed, and its RHS is a smaller normal form. So there is no unwanted expansion, and I see no cycle risk.
findings.proposed_change: Mark it `@[simp]`. The lemma then fires for any `Algebra.leftMulMatrix classSumBasis (classSumCenter C) C' C''` term. Since `classMultMatrix_map_intCast` and `classMultMatrix_eq_leftMulMatrix` give two ways to reach the `leftMulMatrix` form, entries of either form then reduce to `structureConstant` with `simp`. Keep `classMultMatrix_map_intCast` and `classMultMatrix_eq_leftMulMatrix` non-simp, to avoid competing with `classMultMatrix_apply` and `Matrix.map_apply`.
findings.benefit: Users who rewrite a goal with `classMultMatrix_map_intCast` or `classMultMatrix_eq_leftMulMatrix` get a plain `simp` finish. They no longer have to name this lemma in `simp only`. Both views of the matrix then evaluate to the same structure-constant normal form.

    classMultMatrix Cᵢ Cⱼ Cₖ = (structureConstant Cᵢ Cₖ Cⱼ : ℤ)
